meta.description: University of Oxford — oldest university in the English-speaking world (c. 1096).

description: World's second-oldest university in continuous operation. Collegiate research university with 43 colleges. Uses classification system (First, 2:1, 2:2, Third, Pass). Three terms per year: Michaelmas (Oct-Dec), Hilary (Jan-Mar), Trinity (Apr-Jun).

academic_calendar.details: Michaelmas Term (Oct-Dec), Hilary Term (Jan-Mar), Trinity Term (Apr-Jun). Each term has 8-week Full Term. Final exams (Prelims/Finals) at end of academic year.

available.name: Oxford Standard Pattern
available.description: Undergraduate classification degree with First Class Honours (70%+), Upper Second (60-69%), Lower Second (50-59%), Third (45-49%), Pass (40-44%).

available.name: Oxford Postgraduate Pattern
available.description: Postgraduate grading: Distinction (70%+), Merit (65-69%), Pass (50-64%), Fail (below 50%).
